headline: Sammaan Capital Limited: Timely Interest Payment on Listed Secured Redeemable Non-Convertible Debentures
sum: Sammaan Capital Limited notified the NSE that it has made timely interest payments on its publicly-issued Secured Redeemable Non-Convertible Debentures, in compliance with SEBI Regulation 57 disclosure requirements.
detail: Sammaan Capital informed NSE of its timely interest payment on Secured Redeemable Non-Convertible Debentures issued through public issuance and listed on stock exchanges. The notification is mandated under SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, Regulation 57, which requires listed debt issuers to certify timely payment of interest and principal to the exchange. This is a routine regulatory filing confirming debt service compliance.
